description: This file defines the EnvironmentService class in Angular, providing environment-aware configuration management for API endpoints, WebSocket URLs, feature flags, and environment variables. It loads configuration from runtime, window, or process environment sources, with fallback defaults, and offers methods for URL construction and logging control.

classes.name: EnvironmentService
classes.description: Angular service that manages environment-specific configuration, including API URLs, feature flags, environment variables, and logging levels.

methods.name: shouldLog
methods.description: Determines if a message at a given log level should be logged based on current log level settings.

methods.name: toApiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL from a given path fragment, considering backend configuration.

methods.name: healthUrl
methods.description: Returns the full URL for the health check endpoint based on configuration.

methods.name: getApiBase
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL.
